description: Germany only. Employer costs (Arbeitgeberkosten) of one employee in Germany per month and year: gross pay plus the employer share of social security (Sozialversicherung) for full-time, part-time, working students (Werkstudent) and mini-jobs (Minijob), with rates, contribution ceilings and sources. In the transition zone (Midijob, Übergangsbereich) it gives only the lower bound instead of guessing.

brutto_monat.description: Gross pay per month in euro

gesetzlich_versichert.description: Mini-job: person has statutory health insurance, default true

pauschsteuer.description: Mini-job: employer pays the 2 % flat-rate tax, default true

stichtag.description: Month the costs apply to, default today (YYYY-MM-DD)
